From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Evan Gross <evan.gross@cardinaltech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cardinaltech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: CTO introduction + technical runthrough — aligning calendars

Hi Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and propose next steps to keep momentum: 

Recap (2 mins)
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for customer-facing search + contextual prompts (avg seq len ~120 tokens).
- Success metrics: <100ms p50 gen latency for short prompts; initial POC target 50k tokens/day.
- Questions raised: data residency for logs, SOC 2 artifacts, and how we handle prefix caching for multi-tenant workload.

Proposed next step
- VP/CTO intro + technical deep-dive (60 minutes): joint session so we can align architecture, SLA expectations, and show a short live demo of the model serving flow.

Would either of these windows work for your CTO (and your team)?
- Wed 15 Nov — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 16 Nov — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Fri 17 Nov — 14:00–15:00 PT

Please tell us which slot works and who from your side will join so we can tailor the agenda. We’ve attached a one-page agenda and a short pre-read (SOC 2 checklist + flow diagram).

If helpful, here’s my booking link as well: https://cal.com/redwood/60m?u=irene_choi

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the runway.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page, PDF)

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear recap.

Rakul (our CTO) is available Wed 15 Nov at 10:00 PT, that slot works from our side. I’ll confirm Rakul directly but please tentatively hold 11/15 10a PT.

Two quick asks ahead of the call:
1) Can you drop the SOC 2 pre-read and the sample retention policy in a shared link? Our security team will review before the call.
2) Would you include a short section on expected per-token costs at different batch sizes — high level is fine.

I’ll add Rakul and my engineering lead to the invite.

Evan
Head of Product, CardinalTech
evan.gross@cardinaltech.com
